thread:
Ivy: Huge props to Carlos and Mina for the late-night fix on the demo rig. the live customer session wouldve been rough without that hotpatch. :sparkles: :clap:
Carlos: Team effort  Mina found the flaky env var, Harper helped test the fallback, and the infra script did the rest.
Mina: Also shoutout to Design for the quick visuals that made the slides readable at 4x zoom. saved us from squinting. :eyeglasses:
Harper: tossed in a tiny retry for the watcher loop and it held. filed the minimal change in #eng-releases as `watcher-retry: 3`.
DesignBot: posted updated assets to https://files.redwood/designs/demo-safe-mode.png and bumped the demo deck (automated).
Ivy: adding them to the kudos wall. thinking of a "midnight rescue" sticker. anyone have art ideas?
Carlos: maybe a little lifebuoy emoji with a coffee cup. :coffee: :ring_buoy:
Mina: LOL thats perfect. also, I'm sending a $30 coffee card to each person who helped.
Harper: can we formally record this in the weekly roundup? good example of cross-team quick response. :thumbsup:
Ivy: will add a blurb + screenshot to the roundup. thanks everyone for pitching in — small, visible wins like this keep momentum up.
OpsBot: vouchers delivered via DM; kudos logged: Carlos (2), Mina (2), Harper (1). (automated)
Carlos: appreciate it. coffee and a sticker sound like the perfect reward.
Mina: thanks y'all. felt great to unblock the demo and hear the customer say "that worked perfectly." :relieved:
Ivy: <3 ending thread with a photo: https://files.redwood/casual/midnight-rescue.jpg (sneaky, smiling, caffeinated team)
_meta: Slack thread: informal kudos and cross-team thanks. Contains emoji, bot actions, and links. No title per agents.md.
